title: Quercetin improves airway remodeling in COPD rats by suppressing phenotypic switch of ASMCs via inhibiting the Wnt5a/beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Zhou, Hui; Lai, Yingying; Zhu, Yuanyuan; Shao, Feng; Ma, Guangqiang; Yang, Ningning; Ma, Xianhui; Sun, Yinxiang; Shi, Qiang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过Wnt5a/β-catenin通路改善COPD气道重塑，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Airway remodeling in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a contributor to airflow limitation, promotes disease progression, and affects disease outcome and prognosis. Quercetin has been identified as a potential therapeutic agent for COPD. Currently, there is insufficient research providing direct evidence to support this hypothesis. The present study investigates the therapeutic effects and the underlying mechanisms of quercetin in the alleviation of airway remodeling in rat models of COPD. EXPERIMENTAL STEPS: This study used a network pharmacology approach to predict, for the first time, the potential molecular targets of quercetin in COPD. The effects of quercetin on phenotypic switching and mitochondrial function of ASMCs were assessed in vitro using CCK-8, EdU staining, migration assays, western blotting, and JC-1 staining. Additionally, the interaction between Wnt5a and quercetin was analyzed via molecular docking, and findings were experimentally confirmed using the cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). Quercetin's influence on airway remodeling in COPD was examined in vivo through pulmonary function evaluation, H&E staining, and Modified Sirius Red staining. Molecular alterations associated with phenotypic switching, oxidative stress, autophagy and Wnt5a/beta-Catenin pathway were examined by Western blotting, immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry, DHE staining and ELISA. KEY RESULTS: The results showed that quercetin has a beneficial therapeutic effect on COPD. Its ability to mitigate airway remodeling is linked to modulating autophagy levels, reducing oxidative stress, alleviating mitochondrial damage, and influencing the phenotypic switch in ASMCs. By increasing oxidative stress tolerance, quercetin reduces mitochondrial damage and regulates the phenotypic switch in ASMCs. Furthermore, quercetin suppresses autophagy hyperactivation, which subsequently lowers oxidative stress levels in ASMCs. Notably, quercetin modulates autophagy through the regulation of the Wnt5a/beta-catenin signaling pathway. CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: In conclusion, quercetin demonstrates potential therapeutic effects in COPD by suppressing the Wnt5a/beta-cateninsignaling pathway, autophagy as well as oxidative stress, and thereby alleviating mitochondrial damage and the phenotypic switch in ASMCs. These findings may have clinical applications and offer new insights for the development of COPD treatments.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）中的气道重塑是气流受限的促成因素，促进疾病进展，并影响疾病结局和预后。槲皮素已被确定为COPD的潜在治疗药物。目前，支持这一假设的直接证据研究尚不充分。本研究探讨了槲皮素在缓解COPD大鼠模型气道重塑中的治疗效果及其潜在机制。实验步骤：本研究首次采用网络药理学方法预测槲皮素在COPD中的潜在分子靶点。通过CCK-8、EdU染色、迁移实验、Western blotting和JC-1染色，在体外评估了槲皮素对ASMCs表型转换和线粒体功能的影响。此外，通过分子对接分析了Wnt5a与槲皮素之间的相互作用，并利用细胞热位移分析（CETSA）对实验结果进行了验证。通过肺功能评估、H&E染色和改良天狼星红染色，在体内检测了槲皮素对COPD气道重塑的影响。通过Western blotting、免疫荧光、免疫组织化学、DHE染色和ELISA检测了与表型转换、氧化应激、自噬和Wnt5a/β-Catenin通路相关的分子变化。主要结果：结果表明，槲皮素对COPD具有有益的治疗效果。其缓解气道重塑的能力与调节自噬水平、减少氧化应激、减轻线粒体损伤以及影响ASMCs表型转换有关。通过提高氧化应激耐受性，槲皮素减少线粒体损伤并调节ASMCs的表型转换。此外，槲皮素抑制自噬过度激活，进而降低ASMCs中的氧化应激水平。值得注意的是，槲皮素通过调节Wnt5a/β-catenin信号通路来调控自噬。结论与意义：总之，槲皮素通过抑制Wnt5a/β-catenin信号通路、自噬及氧化应激，从而减轻线粒体损伤和ASMCs表型转换，在COPD中显示出潜在的治疗效果。这些发现可能具有临床应用价值，并为COPD治疗的发展提供新见解。
